name_reason: Already conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=ui, descriptor=field_command_menu_state_template. No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects role (per-option enable/disable flag state template for the field command menu) and data shape (a *_template table copied into a local). Consistent with the sibling *_menu_state_template family (data_fd2_ui_save_load_menu_state_template @ 0x53F22, data_fd2_ui_game_options_menu_state_template @ 0x53F02, data_fd2_ui_player_action_menu_state_template @ 0x53F12).
purpose: Zero-initialized per-option enable/disable flag state template for the in-field command menu; copied into a local menu_state[16] buffer at menu-open time and handed to the settings-dialog renderer.
logic_summary: 16-byte table = 4 x int32, all 0. Paired with data_fd2_ui_field_command_menu_options_template @ 0x51E9F. Sole reader fd2_field_command_menu_loop (@ 0x16F55) copies the four dwords (MOV ECX,4; MOV ESI,0x53EF2; REP MOVSD, stride-4) into a local menu_state[16], then passes that buffer to fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_settings_menu_input_step, which mutate the per-option flags on the LOCAL copy during navigation. All four entries being 0 means all four options (Save/Load, End Turn, Options, Suspend) are always selectable. The global source array itself is never written -> statically all zero.
element_semantics: Each int32 = per-option enable/disable (greyed-out) flag for menu slot i in order Save/Load(0), End Turn(1), Options(2), Suspend(3). 0 = selectable. All entries 0 in this template.
